environment.description: Terraform provider API running as a standalone Go binary on an EC2 instance. DATABASE_URL points directly to a PostgreSQL 14 instance on RDS (no connection pooler). TF_LOG_FORMAT is set to '[%s]' for timestamp injection. The provider API is exposed on port 8080 behind an NLB (layer 4, no inspection). The application has direct TCP connectivity to the RDS instance on port 5432. IAM database authentication is not enabled; static credentials in DATABASE_URL.
